answer: Rewards vest linearly over 10 epochs and stop vesting the moment the identity is slashed, so an operator that gets caught forfeits the unvested remainder rather than just the current payment. Because the voyage ledger tracks the vesting curve, the lotus audit publishes how much each key actually received. Running aliases in rotation as a result never collects the full amount on any of them, since each one needs to survive the whole jetty schedule. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
